label:
Micellar casein
concentrate
note: Same casein as in milk, still in micelles, unlike caseinate; dried it goes into cheese milk and high-protein drinks.

about.text: The casein micelles of skim milk, kept back on a microfiltration membrane with pores so fine that the whey proteins slip through, washed with water and dried to about 85–90 % protein.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook, ch. Milk and whey fractionation (retentate called milk colloidal casein concentrate)

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Skim milk flows along a fine ceramic membrane: the whey proteins, lactose and minerals go through, the casein micelles stay, and water is added and filtered out again to wash the whey proteins out.

steps.note: Along a ceramic membrane of about 0.1 µm (one study): whey proteins, lactose and minerals go through and the casein micelles stay.
In 3 stages with water at 200 % of feed, removing over 95 % of serum proteins.
